qualification.details: Senior Research Fellow: First-class post-graduate degree in Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Molecular & Human Genetics/Zoology/Animal Science/Life Sciences with qualified NET/GATE or equivalent examination. Minimum 2 years experience in Parkinson's Disease, neuro-biology, neuronal cell culture, molecular biology and cell biology. Lab Assistant: Graduate (at least 55% marks) with experience in mice handling and laboratory reagent preparation. Junior Research Fellow: M.Sc. in Zoology/Life Sciences/Biochemistry/Biotechnology or related area with at least 55% marks and qualified NET/GATE. Desirable: knowledge of cell culture, animal experiments, molecular biology techniques such as RT-qPCR, ChIP-qPCR, non-coding RNA and epigenetics.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for BHU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BHU Research Positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the BHU Research Positions is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Positions at BHU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for Research Positions at Banaras Hindu University. These include Senior Research Fellow, Lab Assistant, and Junior Research Fellow posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Lab Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Lab Assistant position, candidates need to be a Graduate with at least 55% marks and possess experience in mice handling and laboratory reagent preparation.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for BHU Research Positions?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the BHU Research Positions recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month along with 18% HRA. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these BHU posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the BHU Research Positions typically involves a Written Test, followed by an Interview, Document Verification, and finally the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with a Master's degree apply for the Lab Assistant role?
faq.answer: While a Graduate degree with 55% marks and relevant experience is the minimum requirement for the Lab Assistant post, candidates with a Master's degree can also apply if they meet the criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for BHU Research Positions?
faq.answer: The application mode for these positions is via Email. Candidates need to prepare their application and send it to the designated email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Does BHU offer any age relaxation for female candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, BHU offers age relaxation for female candidates. They are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years, along with SC/ST/PH candidates.
